rules.statement: Artist один раз за игру днём может наедине задать Ведущему любой вопрос.
rules.reason: The engine records the private question and spends the Artist's once-per-game ability; the cited test asserts both, so only the atomic-map entry is missing.
rules.evidence: src/core/engine/snv.test.ts::the Artist records one private yes/no question and spends the ability (SNV-ARTIST-01) — asserts the stored question, the host answer, used.artist true, a second question rejected, and the question absent from publicGameView.

rules.statement: Ведущий честно отвечает "Yes", "No" или "I don't know".
rules.reason: The engine accepts only yes, no and unknown, and the cited test rejects an invalid answer without spending the ability. The honesty clause remains table conduct.
rules.evidence: src/core/engine/snv.test.ts::the Artist command rejects an empty question, an invalid answer and a player without the character (SNV-ARTIST-01) — an invalid `banish` answer is rejected and `used.artist` stays unset.

rules.statement: Разговор приватный; группа не может его слышать.
rules.reason: The group cannot listen to a private conversation; the test asserts the exchange is absent from public data, which is the app limit. Table privacy remains player conduct.
evidence: test: src/core/engine/snv.test.ts::a host answer to the Dreamer and the Sage changes no game state and stays private (SNV-DREAMER-01, SNV-SAGE-01).

rules.statement: Инициатива разговора принадлежит Artist, а не Ведущему.
rules.reason: Who initiates the private conversation is table procedure and player conduct; the engine cannot force the Artist to speak first.
rules.evidence: Artist r3156 §Summary; no test asserts initiative. The command only requires the character holder (src/core/engine/day.ts dayAbilityHolder).

rules.statement: Если на вопрос нельзя ответить "да", "нет" или "не знаю", Ведущий просит переформулировать.
rules.reason: Asking the Artist to rephrase is a Storyteller presentation step with no engine state; the engine accepts a question and a host answer.
rules.evidence: Artist r3156 §How to Run; no engine behavior or test.

rules.statement: После вопроса Artist теряет способность.
rules.reason: The cited test asserts that used.artist becomes true and a second question is rejected, which is the loss of the ability.
rules.evidence: src/core/engine/snv.test.ts::the Artist records one private yes/no question and spends the ability (SNV-ARTIST-01) — asserts used.artist true and the second command rejected.

rules.statement: Каждую ночь Cerenovus выбирает игрока и good-персонажа (Townsfolk или Outsider).
rules.reason: The cited test builds the Cerenovus step on the first and a later night with one player target and only good role choices, which is the sentence.
rules.evidence: src/core/engine/snv.test.ts::the Cerenovus has a step on every night, choosing one player and a good character (SNV-CERENOVUS-01) — asserts minTargets/maxTargets 1 and roleChoices limited to the good roles.

rules.statement: Выбранный игрок узнаёт, что должен быть mad, что он этот персонаж, на следующий день.
rules.reason: The chosen player is told by the Storyteller with a token and a spoken reminder; the engine stores the madness for the host and deliberately keeps it out of player projections, so this is table presentation.
rules.evidence: Cerenovus r3048 §How to Run; src/core/engine/snv.test.ts::madness stays out of the public and player projections.

rules.statement: Если Ведущий считает, что игрок недостаточно старался убедить группу, он может казнить его днём или ночью.
rules.reason: Whether the player made enough effort and whether to execute is the Storyteller's judgment; the engine exposes the legal penalty command, not the decision.
rules.evidence: Cerenovus r3048 §How to Run; src/core/engine/snv.test.ts::the madness penalty only accepts the legal Storyteller options.

rules.statement: Простого намёка недостаточно; игрок должен приложить заметное усилие.
rules.reason: Whether a hint is a noticeable effort is a Storyteller judgment about table behavior, not engine state.
rules.evidence: Cerenovus r3048 §Summary; no engine behavior or test.

rules.statement: Mad evil-игрок тоже может быть казнён, но Ведущий может этого не делать, чтобы evil не выигрывал этим способом.
rules.reason: "Might" leaves the execution of a mad evil player to the Storyteller; the engine accepts a no-penalty review.
rules.evidence: Cerenovus r3048 §Summary; src/core/engine/snv.test.ts::a no-penalty madness review can be upgraded to execution later that day.

rules.statement: Казнь за нарушение madness считается единственной казнью дня.
rules.reason: A madness execution is asserted to count as the day's execution and to stop the Vortox no-execution win, so the shared day-execution path is evidenced.
rules.evidence: src/core/engine/crossrole-oracle.test.ts::a madness execution counts as the day's execution and stops the Vortox win (SNV-CERENOVUS-01, SNV-VORTOX-01) — the source-derived cross-role test.

rules.statement: Игрок никогда не обязан быть mad; казнь — решение Ведущего.
rules.reason: Player conduct: the pinned States § Madness says players are never forced to be mad, and the execution stays the Storyteller's judgement. No engine-visible consequence.
rules.evidence: wiki: docs/official/wiki/States.r1039.wikitext § Madness — "Players are never forced to be mad"; the penalty is a Storyteller choice recorded by `madnessPenalty`.

rules.statement: Evil Travellers не считаются Minions для этой способности.
rules.reason: Out of edition scope: Grimoria models neither Travellers nor exile, so an evil Traveller never reaches the Minion distance search. The register keeps the sentence with its pinned source; it is not an engine gap.
rules.evidence: wiki: docs/official/wiki/Clockmaker.r2967.wikitext § Examples; no Traveller or exile model (untested by design).

rules.statement: Каждую ночь Dreamer выбирает игрока, кроме себя и Travellers.
rules.reason: Out of edition scope for Travellers, with self-exclusion already asserted: the pinned Summary says "not yourself or Travellers", Grimoria models no Travellers, and the engine refuses the Dreamer as a target.
rules.evidence: src/core/engine/snv.test.ts::the Dreamer cannot choose themself (SNV-DREAMER-01); no Traveller model by design.

rules.statement: Dreamer не может выбрать себя или Traveller.
rules.reason: Out of edition scope for Travellers, with self-exclusion already asserted: Grimoria models no Travellers, so the engine cannot be asked to refuse one.
rules.evidence: src/core/engine/snv.test.ts::the Dreamer cannot choose themself (SNV-DREAMER-01); no Traveller model by design.

rules.statement: Dreamer узнаёт два персонажа: один правильный и один неправильный; один из них good, другой evil.
rules.reason: The cited test asserts one true character plus one opposite-kind false character, which is the sentence.
rules.evidence: src/core/engine/snv.test.ts::a sober Dreamer offers only the target's character with an opposite-kind character (SNV-DREAMER-01).

rules.statement: Если выбран Townsfolk или Outsider, ложный персонаж — Minion или Demon; если выбран Minion или Demon, ложный персонаж — Townsfolk или Outsider.
rules.reason: Both target kinds are asserted: a Townsfolk target gets a Minion/Demon false character, and a Minion target gets a Townsfolk/Outsider false character.
rules.evidence: src/core/engine/snv.test.ts::a sober Dreamer shows a Minion or Demon target's character as the evil member (SNV-DREAMER-01) — every legal pair holds the Minion `cerenovus` as the evil member.

rules.statement: Dreamer не узнаёт, какой из двух персонажей верен.
rules.reason: The host-answer test asserts the Dreamer pair is a secret host choice, absent from publicGameView, and the stored pair has no truth field.
evidence: test: src/core/engine/snv.test.ts::a host answer to the Dreamer and the Sage changes no game state and stays private (SNV-DREAMER-01, SNV-SAGE-01).

rules.statement: При Vortox оба показанных персонажа должны быть ложными.
rules.reason: The cited test asserts that under a living Vortox the true character is not offered, so both shown characters are false.
rules.evidence: src/core/engine/snv.test.ts::an impaired Dreamer may show any good and evil pair, a Vortox forbids the true one (SNV-DREAMER-01).

rules.statement: Если good-игрок становится Evil Twin, он остаётся good, а его близнец — evil.
rules.reason: The cited test turns a good player into the Evil Twin and pairs them with an evil player, asserting both alignments stay as they are.
rules.evidence: src/core/engine/twin-correction.test.ts::the host can pair a good player who became the Evil Twin with an evil player (SNV-EVILTWIN-05) — realTeamOf the holder is good and the partner is evil.

rules.statement: Если оба близнеца одного alignment, Ведущий выбирает нового Twin.
rules.reason: The cited test makes the pair same-alignment, asserts the pair has no ability and the host must choose a new twin, then records the replacement.
rules.evidence: src/core/engine/twin-correction.test.ts::a same-alignment pair becomes invalid and needs a new choice (SNV-EVILTWIN-05).

rules.statement: Выбирать Traveller в качестве Twin обычно не рекомендуется.
rules.reason: A recommendation about which player to pick, not a mechanical rule; no engine consequence.
rules.evidence: Evil_Twin.r3101 §How to Run ("It is rarely a good idea to choose a Traveller to be a Twin."); no test.

rules.statement: Поднятие руки не за казнь (например, за изгнание Traveller) не учитывается.
rules.reason: Out of edition scope: Grimoria models neither Travellers nor exile, so a non-execution hand raise has no engine path. The register keeps the sentence with its pinned source; it is not an engine gap.
rules.evidence: wiki: docs/official/wiki/Flowergirl.r2907.wikitext § Summary; no exile model (untested by design).

rules.statement: Если Ведущий забыл, голосовал ли Demon, рекомендуется спросить Demon ночью, показав DID YOU VOTE TODAY.
rules.reason: A recovery procedure for a forgotten vote, using a table token and a question to the Demon; no engine state.
rules.evidence: Flowergirl r2907 §How to Run; no test.

rules.statement: Догадки должны быть публичными, чтобы все их слышали.
rules.reason: Public guessing is player conduct; the app journal is host-only, so the engine cannot make the table hear a guess.
evidence: code: src/core/engine/day.ts — the Juggler journal entry is secret.

rules.statement: Узнав о своей смерти, Klutz должен публично объявить себя Klutz и выбрать живого игрока вскоре после смерти.
rules.reason: The choice, its timing and the living-target rule are asserted; the remaining clause, publicly declaring that they are the Klutz, is player conduct at the table with no engine state.
rules.evidence: src/core/engine/snv.test.ts::the Klutz public choice resolves the game as soon as the Klutz learns of the death (SNV-KLUTZ-01) and ::a recorded Klutz choice finishes the queued step and a dead target does not strand it (SNV-KLUTZ-01); no assertion of the spoken declaration.

rules.statement: Klutz может взять несколько минут и получить совет, но решение принимает сам.
rules.reason: Taking a few minutes and receiving advice is table conduct; the Klutz's decision is the player's, and the engine records the chosen target.
rules.evidence: Klutz r1758 §Summary; no engine behavior or test.

rules.statement: Намеренное уклонение от выбора считается читерством.
rules.reason: Deliberately avoiding the choice is cheating by player conduct; there is no engine consequence to assert.
rules.evidence: Klutz r1758 §Summary; no engine behavior or test.

rules.statement: Регистрация Recluse как evil для Chef или смерть poisoned Soldier от Imp считаются аномалиями; получение poisoned Empath истинной информации — нет.
rules.reason: The examples define when the Storyteller should consider an ability abnormal; the engine records host-marked anomalies and never infers the cause.
rules.evidence: Mathematician r3153 §Summary; src/core/engine/information-facts.ts states the Storyteller marks each abnormal working, and src/core/engine/snv.test.ts::the Storyteller marks abnormal abilities and the Mathematician counts them — the host supplies the reason.

rules.statement: Если Ведущий считает, что Mutant mad about being an Outsider, он может казнить Mutant.
rules.reason: Whether the Mutant is "mad about being an Outsider" and whether to execute is the Storyteller's judgment; the engine only stores the madness review.
rules.evidence: Mutant r1755 §How to Run; src/core/engine/snv.test.ts::the Mutant is mad about being an Outsider while in play (SNV-MUTANT-01) asserts the token, not the judgment.

rules.statement: Казнь Mutant может произойти в любое время, даже вне фазы номинаций или ночью.
rules.reason: The cited test executes the Mutant on the first night, asserting that the penalty can occur outside the nomination phase and at night.
rules.evidence: src/core/engine/snv.test.ts::a Mutant can be executed on the first night (Mutant r1755).

rules.statement: Если Mutant казнён днём до обычной казни, день переходит в ночь; в этот день больше нет казни.
rules.reason: A madness execution is asserted to count as the day's execution and stop the Vortox no-execution win, so the day ends and no second execution follows on the shared path.
rules.evidence: src/core/engine/crossrole-oracle.test.ts::a madness execution counts as the day's execution and stops the Vortox win (SNV-CERENOVUS-01, SNV-VORTOX-01) — the same day-execution path the Mutant uses.

rules.statement: Если Mutant намекает на своё безумие ночью, Ведущий может казнить его этой ночью, даже если казнь уже была сегодня; на следующий день казнь всё ещё возможна.
rules.reason: A day execution followed by a night madness execution and a further next-day execution is asserted: the night execution is outside the day limit and consumes nothing.
rules.evidence: src/core/engine/snv.test.ts::a night Mutant execution is allowed after a day execution and leaves the next day free (SNV-MUTANT-01) — the night death is allowed and the next day executes again.

rules.statement: Игрок никогда не обязан быть mad; казнь — следствие выбора Ведущего, а не принуждение игрока.
rules.reason: Player conduct: the pinned States § Madness says players are never forced to be mad; the execution is the Storyteller's choice, not engine pressure. No engine-visible consequence.
rules.evidence: wiki: docs/official/wiki/States.r1039.wikitext § Madness — "Players are never forced to be mad".

rules.statement: Ведущий — окончательный судья того, пытается ли Mutant убедить группу.
rules.reason: Storyteller judgement: the pinned States § Madness makes the Storyteller the final judge of whether a player is behaving madly. No engine-visible consequence.
rules.evidence: wiki: docs/official/wiki/States.r1039.wikitext § Madness — "You, the Storyteller, are the final judge about who is and who is not behaving madly".

rules.statement: Если создан Demon, смерти этой ночью арбитрарны: Ведущий может выбрать, кого убить или защитить.
rules.reason: After a Demon is created the Storyteller chooses whom to kill or protect; the engine exposes the arbitrary-death flag and records host-marked deaths, so the decision itself is host adjudication.
rules.evidence: Pit-Hag r2998 §How to Run; src/core/engine/snv.test.ts::a Demon the Pit-Hag makes does not wake tonight, and the host marks the night's deaths on the Pit-Hag's step (SNV-PITHAG-01) — asserts canKill, not the chosen victims.

rules.statement: Если Pit-Hag меняет Demon на нового Demon, рекомендуется не допускать смертей этой ночью; при создании evil Demon рекомендуется убить старого Demon и ещё одного игрока.
rules.reason: Advice about which deaths to choose when a Demon is created; no engine rule.
rules.evidence: Pit-Hag r2998 §How to Run; no test.

rules.statement: Если Sage умирает в ранней игре, Ведущий обычно показывает двух живых игроков; в финальную ночь можно показать одного живого и одного мёртвого.
rules.reason: Which two players the Storyteller points at, and the early-game versus final-night guidance, is presentation and advice; the engine accepts the host's pair.
rules.evidence: Sage r3009 §How to Run; src/core/engine/snv.test.ts::a sober Sage offers only pairs with the Demon that killed them (SNV-SAGE-01) asserts the constraint, not the recommended living/dead mix.

rules.statement: Каждый день Savant может прийти к Ведущему наедине; он не обязан этого делать.
rules.reason: Whether the Savant visits is the player's choice; the engine does not require a visit, so there is no engine consequence to assert.
rules.evidence: Savant r2910 §Summary; src/core/engine/snv.test.ts::the Savant records two statements and one true statement, once per day (SNV-SAVANT-01) asserts only the visit path.

rules.statement: Ведущий сообщает две вещи, одна из которых истинна, другая ложна.
rules.reason: Both forgotten branches are rejected for a healthy Savant: `both` and `neither` fail, so exactly one true statement is enforced.
rules.evidence: src/core/engine/snv.test.ts::the Savant information stays one true and one false unless impaired (SNV-SAVANT-02) — the healthy `neither` answer is rejected alongside `both`.

rules.statement: Savant не узнаёт, какая из двух вещей истинна.
rules.reason: The Savant statement tests assert both statements are absent from publicGameView; the truth field is host-only and no player projection exposes it.
evidence: test: src/core/engine/snv.test.ts::the Savant records two statements and one true statement, once per day (SNV-SAVANT-01).
test: src/core/engine/snv.test.ts::a living Vortox makes both Savant statements false (SNV-SAVANT-03).

rules.statement: Разговор приватный; группа не может его слышать.
rules.reason: The cited test asserts that the private statements are absent from publicGameView, which is the privacy clause.
rules.evidence: src/core/engine/snv.test.ts::the Savant records two statements and one true statement, once per day (SNV-SAVANT-01) — asserts publicGameView does not contain the statements.

rules.statement: Если Savant drunk или poisoned, он может получить две истины или две лжи.
rules.reason: An impaired Savant is accepted with two true statements and with two false statements.
rules.evidence: src/core/engine/snv.test.ts::the Savant information stays one true and one false unless impaired (SNV-SAVANT-02) — `both` and `neither` are each allowed while poisoned.

rules.statement: При Vortox обе информации должны быть ложными.
rules.reason: The cited test rejects a true statement and accepts "neither" under a living Vortox, asserting both statements false.
rules.evidence: src/core/engine/snv.test.ts::a living Vortox makes both Savant statements false (SNV-SAVANT-03).

rules.statement: Информация должна быть полезной и связанной с игрой; не следует прямо называть Demon.
rules.reason: Advice about useful, game-related information and not naming the Demon; no engine rule.
rules.evidence: Savant r2910 §How to Run; no test.

rules.statement: Ведущий выбирает цель; обычно это Townsfolk, но может быть Outsider, Minion или Demon.
rules.reason: The target is the Storyteller's choice; the engine accepts any player and the "usually Townsfolk" clause is guidance, not a restriction.
rules.evidence: Sweetheart r2704 §How to Run; src/core/engine/snv.test.ts::the Sweetheart makes the chosen player permanently drunk (SNV-SWEETHEART-01) asserts the effect, not a target-type rule.

rules.statement: Изгнание Traveller не считается номинацией для этой способности.
rules.reason: Out of edition scope: Grimoria models neither Travellers nor exile, so a Traveller exile never becomes a nomination. The register keeps the sentence with its pinned source; it is not an engine gap.
rules.evidence: wiki: docs/official/wiki/Town_Crier.r3145.wikitext § Examples; no exile model (untested by design).

rules.statement: Если Ведущий забыл, рекомендуется спросить каждого Minion ночью, показав DID YOU NOMINATE TODAY.
rules.reason: A recovery procedure for a forgotten nomination, using a table token and a question to each Minion; no engine state.
rules.evidence: Town_Crier.r3145 §How to Run; no test.

rules.statement: Любая информация, которую Townsfolk получает от своей способности, должна быть ложной — даже если игрок drunk или poisoned.
rules.reason: The cited tests assert that the true answer is removed and a false host answer is required under a living Vortox, including when the information role is impaired.
rules.evidence: src/core/engine/snv.test.ts::a living Vortox forbids the true Clockmaker distance (SNV-CLOCKMAKER-02) and ::an impaired Clockmaker under a living Vortox is offered only false numbers (SNV-CLOCKMAKER-02).

rules.statement: Vortox не влияет на информацию, полученную иным путём: объяснение правил, смена персонажа или alignment.
rules.reason: A character change under a living Vortox is asserted to stay truthful: the Pit-Hag note names the new character and carries no false-information clause.
rules.evidence: src/core/engine/snv.test.ts::a living Vortox leaves a character-change note truthful (SNV-VORTOX-02) — the change note is `note.characterBecame`, names the character and has no false suffix.

rules.statement: Изгнание Traveller не считается казнью для условия победы Vortox.
rules.reason: Out of edition scope: Grimoria models neither Travellers nor exile, so an exile never reaches the Vortox execution condition. The register keeps the sentence with its pinned source; it is not an engine gap.
rules.evidence: wiki: docs/official/wiki/Vortox.r3017.wikitext § Examples; no exile model (untested by design).
